text:
Mina: Random question of the day 1 what's the strangest thing you've ever eaten (accidental or on purpose)? No judgement. :fork_and_knife:
Ben: Ate a whole jar of kimchi straight out of the fridge at 2am once. Regrets + glory. :face_with_head_bandage:
Harper: I once tried smoked watermelon at a food market. It was shockingly good. Also confusing. :watermelon:
Ravi: Accidentally ate someones experimental 'protein snack' at a hackathon. Tasted like savory foam. Still can't describe it.
Mina: "Savory foam" is my favorite culinary crime descriptor. :joy:
Ben: Also once tried a hot honey & sriracha ice cream at a festival. It was divisive but I defended it.
Harper: There's a diner here that serves pickled mango with breakfast. I'm now a convert.
Ravi: Worst accidental: bite into a pastry thinking it was almond when it was actually marzipan and I'm allergic. Had to nap for an hour.
Mina: Yikes. Hope you carried antihistamines after that.
Ravi: Always now. Learned the hard way.
Ben: Best deliberate weirdness: black garlic chocolate truffles. Unholy and wonderful.
Harper: I once ate fried locusts at a cultural fair. Crunchy and slightly nutty. Felt like a tiny dinosaur snack. :bug:
Mina: @Harper please send photo of tiny dinosaur snack.
Harper: <https://i.imgur.com/placeholder_locust.jpg|locust-fair.jpg> (lower-res, terrifying)
Ben: Bonus category: what would you *never* eat?
Ravi: Sea urchin. Respectfully out.
Mina: Cilantro ice cream. I will not be your cilantro dessert guinea pig.
Harper: Anything labeled "mystery meat" at a gas station. Boundaries.
Ben: This should be a Slack cookbook thread. "Weird but lovable" recipes only.
Mina: I vote we make a channel for it or maybe a rotating "Try-and-report" Friday. @emoji-bot add reaction :popcorn: for cookbook idea.
emoji-bot: :popcorn: added to message 1805554321.
Ravi: If we do a Try-and-report, I volunteer to bring black garlic truffles for moral support.
Harper: I will curate an ethical insect snack list.
Mina: Love this. Thanks team 1 low-stakes taste testing is officially approved. :sparkles:
